description: A single-select control with two render paths behind one API: a rich Popover-API listbox (the default) whose options carry icons, badges and a selected mark, or a native `<select>` for flat, OS-native cases. The rich control is a framed field on the same geometry as Input; its panel and rows resolve the shared dropdown tokens, so a Select listbox and a Dropdown menu are the same surface. The panel is placed by the stylesheet with CSS anchor positioning against an anchor the component wires itself, so a headless panel needs placing by your own CSS; keyboard, typeahead, focus and form submission are owned by the headless primitive.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
When `true`, Root delegates to a single consumer-supplied element
(expected to render a `<select>`) and merges its own props onto it
via the {@link Slot } pattern. Placeholder-detection inside Root
walks direct children only in this mode, so the `asChild` +
placeholder combination requires the consumer to set
`defaultValue=""` explicitly.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content of the select — typically {@link SelectOption }, {@link SelectGroup },
and optionally a leading {@link SelectPlaceholder }.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Rich mode only — whether the listbox popover is open on first render.
Ignored under `native` (the browser owns the popup). Uncontrolled: pass
this (or omit for closed) and let the component manage the state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the option selected on first render. When omitted and a
{@link SelectPlaceholder } is present among Root's direct children,
Root infers `""` automatically so the placeholder is the initial
selection.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value` instead.

props.name: native
props.description:
Selects the render path:

- `false` (the default) — the **rich** render path: a fully-styleable
  Popover-API listbox built from {@link SelectTrigger `Select.Trigger`},
  {@link SelectValue `Select.Value`},
  {@link SelectContent `Select.Content`} and
  {@link SelectItem `Select.Item`}. Icons and other rich content on an
  item render as authored.
- `true` — the **native** render path: a thin wrapper over a real
  `<select>` / `<option>` / `<optgroup>`, for flat, OS-native cases
  (mobile wheel pickers, maximum-compatibility forms). Under `native`,
  {@link SelectItem `Select.Item`} renders an `<option>` from its
  string/number children only — element children (icons, indicators)
  are dropped.

Both modes share the same `value` / `onValueChange` / `disabled` / form
`name` API.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Native `change` handler. Fires alongside `onValueChange` whenever the
user picks a different option. Use this when you want the raw
`ChangeEvent` (e.g. to inspect `event.target.validity`).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Rich mode only — called with the next open state whenever the listbox
opens or closes (trigger click, selection, Escape, light-dismiss).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new option value whenever the user changes the
selection. Optional in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the new option value whenever the user changes the
selection. Required in controlled mode.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Control scale; `data-density` scales the sizing within each size. Re-points the frame (height/padding/radius/gap/icon) and the typography. On `SelectContent` the same axis re-points the panel + row sizing knobs.

contractProps.name: mode
contractProps.description: Which render path the frame is dressing. `rich` lays the control out as `[leading][value][chevron]`; `native` leaves the inner layout and the popup to the platform, but paints its own chevron (matching the rich one's shape/size/inset) over the UA's default arrow.

contractProps.name: placement
contractProps.description: Which side of the trigger the panel opens on, via anchor-positioning insets on `SelectContent`. The `anchor-name` / `position-anchor` pair is wired by the component from a `useId`-derived ident, so nothing is required of the consumer.

elements.example: Fruit Apple Banana Carrot

api.description:
`<primitiv-select>` — a value chosen from a list that opens from a trigger (WAI-ARIA APG select-only combobox, as a button and a listbox).

The root owns the state: `value`, the chosen item, and `open`, both reflected. The `<button>` inside `<primitiv-select-trigger>` opens and closes the list; `<primitiv-select-content>` is the list, a `popover="auto"` panel in the top layer that closes on a press outside or Escape. Opening focuses the selected item (else the first); the arrows, Home and End move, typing jumps to the item it starts, and Enter, Space or a click chooses — which closes the list and hands focus back to the trigger.

With a `name` it takes part in forms like a native select: it keeps a visually hidden `<select>` inside itself, so the value submits, `required` validates and `disabled` leaves it out, and a form reset restores the value it first rendered with.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The chosen item's value. Reflected: it changes as the user chooses, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees it.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the list is showing. Reflected.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name the value submits under. Without one the select takes no part in forms.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid while nothing is chosen.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Leaves the value out of the form. Disable the trigger's `<button>` to stop it opening.

events.name: primitiv-select-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a chosen value is applied. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it; the list closes either way.

events.name: primitiv-select-open-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before the list opens or closes. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-select-trigger>` — an interactive part: it decorates exactly one child you write, a `<button>`, which opens and closes the list and gets `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Put a `<primitiv-select-value>` inside the button to show the choice.
`<primitiv-select-value>` — a structural part: shows a copy of the chosen item's content (its indicator left out), or the `placeholder` with `data-placeholder` set while nothing is chosen.
`<primitiv-select-content>` — a structural part: the list itself, `role="listbox"` and `popover="auto"`, shown in the top layer while the select is open.

`<primitiv-select-item>` — a structural part: one choice. The element is the option itself (`role="option"`), with `aria-selected` and `data-state="checked" | "unchecked"`, focused as the arrows move.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value the select takes when this item is chosen.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Skipped by the arrows and typeahead, and never chosen (`aria-disabled` and `data-disabled`).

api.description: `<primitiv-select-item-indicator>` — a structural part: a mark inside an item, `hidden` unless that item is chosen, with `data-state`. Left out of the value part's copy.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep it shown while its item is unchosen, to animate it from `data-state`.

api.description: `<primitiv-select-group>` — a structural part: a named cluster of items, `role="group"`.
`<primitiv-select-separator>` — a structural part: a divider between items, `role="separator"`.
